title: Bodycam: Angry Florida Man Shot Walmart Drone with His Pistol
description:
Bodycam footage shows the arrest of a Florida man who said he shot a drone that was above his property on June 26. The Lake County Sheriff’s Office said they received a 911 call from Walmart employees saying a delivery drone was shot while en route. Deputies spoke with Dennis Winn, 72, who immediately copped to shooting at the flying device. Winn was charged with shooting at an aircraft, criminal mischief damage over $1,000, and discharging a firearm in residential property.
